findings_so_far: ANGLE 1 DETERMINISM — HOLDS, AND HARDER THAN CLAIMED. My own independently written probe reproduces all 40 of the builder's stored 8 s bed|tod digests EXACTLY: different tool, different process, different browser launch, different commit (0f6ff17 -> 444d43d), 18 minutes later, reverse capture order, loadavg 13-19 vs the builder's. 40/40 same, 0 diff.

AND UNDER THE CONDITIONS THE FENCE NEVER TESTS: 60 s captures (1-5 L3/L4 events per bed, vs 0 at 8 s), listener placed ON the emitter so R7 renders, both capture orders, four separate browser processes, loads 13.1-18.9. Every bed bit-identical in every arm.

BUT THE SHIPPED FENCE IS BLIND TO HALF OF R3. reports/w1-22/ambience-determinism.json records fired: 0 for ALL FORTY bed x tod rows -- the default --seconds 8 is shorter than every L3 interval band (min 8 s), and the tool hardcodes listener: null. So the '20 beds, 2 tod, 3 captures, bit-identical' headline is a claim about the continuous bed alone. The seeded event scheduler (R3's actual subject) and the R7 emitters -- the two things that put voices into the DeterministicMixer's ROTATING grain lanes -- are never exercised by the standing gate.

R5 FINDING: at 60 s, listener none, NIGHT IS BIT-IDENTICAL TO DAY for 9 of 13 regions (clay-moor, crimson-coast, deep-marshes, eastern-rootlands, hive, salt-hills, stone-wastes, thornmarsh, valus-ridge). Only blackwood, marauders-coast, stone-forest, western-rootlands differ.

SUCCESSOR-2 / AMENDMENT A: the three headline numbers REPRODUCE exactly off reports/w1-22/ambience-onsets.json (median bed-alone crest 12.25 vs claimed 12.3; median mix crest 16.05 vs 16.2; 3 of 40 clips >=20 dB). But the DERIVATION does not hold. It rests on 'a short grain carries 6-10 dB of its own peak-to-RMS'; measured from the same report over 419 events that quantity is 4.4-23.0 dB, median 10.94, p90 17.30, with 61.6% ABOVE 10 dB. At the p90 grain a clip reaches 20 dB crest with the event at +2.70 dB rel bed, INSIDE RI-AUD03 SectionA's band. Empirical counterexamples: thornmarsh reaches 19.1 dB crest with its loudest L3 at +0.01 rel bed, salt-hills 19.5 dB with +1.49. So 'the two clauses cannot both be satisfied' is FALSE as stated; it is true of the MEDIAN grain only.

SUCCESSOR-2 / AMENDMENT A, the harder half: the amendment says 'I am not proposing to widen SectionA's band, and I have not widened it' and calls what the build does 'in every case the conservative reading'. The build HAS widened it in fact. The Hive ships chitin_scrape at +10.23 and +10.61 dB rel bed -- 8.6 dB outside SectionA's L3 cap of +2 and exactly the '+10 dB' the amendment's own arithmetic predicts -- and that single event is the ONLY reason the Hive is the one bed clearing the judge's 20 dB bar (23.3 dB; drop it and the clip sits at 19.1). Gate O3 reports pass with ZERO failures because O3 grades the layer MEDIAN, which eleven quiet cell_ticks hold at -2.00.

SUCCESSOR-2 / IN-BAND-THEN-BURIED IS NOT FIXED, it is fixed AT THE MEDIAN. `event_gain_db` is one trim PER LAYER; `synth.gain_db` varies PER EVENT (-5..-13). A per-layer trim cannot unbury an event quieter than its layer-mates. Measured: 11 of 33 bed/layer pairs pass O3's median while containing an out-of-band event; between-event spread within a layer is median 10.82 dB over 11 multi-event layers, worst 17.48 dB. blackwood/distant_axe -- one of the three sounds the bed's OWN `brief` advertises -- renders at -18.8 dB rel bed, 12.8 dB below SectionA's L3 floor. Also well/stone_shift -16.3, dungeon/block_settle -11.1, western-rootlands/reed_snap -9.8.

SUCCESSOR-2 / DECLARED CHAIN vs RENDER: level_db + synth.gain_db + event_gain_db predicts the rendered rel_db with median error -1.09 dB but p90 |err| 14.96 dB and max 20.78 dB. The piece's own diagnosis ('loudness is not the sum of the numbers you typed') still holds after the fix, for individual events.

SUCCESSOR-2 / DETECTOR REFUSAL LOCATED: ambience-onsets.mjs:416 guards every subtraction with `if (!muteWorks.ok || muteWorks.muted !== 0) ... 'Refusing to report.' exit(2)`. It checks that the MUTED arm fired nothing; it NEVER checks that the UNMUTED arm fired anything. The shipped fixture is blackwood/4 s/8 kHz and the stored report records full:0, muted:0, ok:true -- BOTH ARMS EMPTY, because 4 s is shorter than the shortest L3 interval band (blackwood L3 interval_s [8,24]). The refusal is real code on a reachable branch but is unreachable for the reason it exists. Browser falsification pending in tools/audio/critic-w1-22-r2-probe.mjs P1.

SUCCESSOR-2 / AMENDMENT B VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY off the 13 shipped bed `key` fields: 7 distinct triples, 10 of 13 regions sharing one. Amendment B holds and RI-AUD03 SectionC's 'no duplicate triples except one group of four' is false. This is load-bearing for the pack design.

SUCCESSOR-2 / RE-MEASURED AT HEAD 5d88b7e, 180 s x 40 bed-tod rows, own tool tools/audio/critic-w1-22-r2-bands.mjs over a fresh ambience-onsets run: 54 of 413 measured events sit OUTSIDE RI-AUD03 SectionA's band with the tool's own +/-2 dB tolerance -- 33 BURIED, 21 SHOUTING. Gate O3 reports pass with zero failures on the same render. Falsification arms behave: --sabotage widen (spread x3) 182/413 outside; --sabotage centre (every event collapsed onto its layer median, the shape O3 CAN see) 0/413 outside and B1 goes GREEN. So B1's red is exactly the information O3's median discards.

SUCCESSOR-2 / DELETE-THE-FIX DETERMINISM COUNT: the brief's '8 of 20 beds, not 2' is CORRECT. reports/w1-22/ambience-determinism-sab-flatmix.json D1 lists 8 failing beds (crimson-coast, deep-marshes, eastern-rootlands, street, well, stone-forest, valus-ridge, western-rootlands) of 20 measured. Note D1's `pass: true` in that file is NOT a green build -- under --sabotage flatmix the pass predicate is `d1.length > 0`, i.e. the falsifier is required to fire, and it did. But that bar would be met by ONE bed; the count 8 is reported, not gated.

SUCCESSOR-2 / IEEE-754 ROOT CAUSE HOLDS AND IS THE BEST EVIDENCE IN THE PIECE. D0_platform_control drives BARE browser audio nodes with no project code: summing 4 and 8 oscillators onto ONE node is non-identical run-to-run (max_abs 3.0e-8 / 4.5e-8, 12901 and 18219 nonzero samples of 32000); the same oscillators summed two at a time down a chain are bit-identical at every arity 1,2,3,4,8. It reproduces identically in the clean and the sabotage arm, which is what a platform property should do.

SUCCESSOR-2 / BLIND PACK: the r2 pack at reports/w1-22-critic/r2/pack IS NOT FIT TO BE JUDGED. Three mechanical tells, found by auditing it before spending a judge (the discipline the sibling r4-prose voiding established): (1) SERIALISED LENGTH -- |len(A)-len(B)| median 46 bytes on SAME vs 86 on DIFFERENT; a single threshold on byte count alone recovers 0.769 of the key against a 0.500 chance baseline. (2) TIME OF DAY IS THE CLASS -- all 13 SAME trials are (day,day) or (day,night), 8 of 13 DIFFERENT are (night,night), and NO DIFFERENT trial mixes the two, so 'the sides differ in time of day' implies SAME with certainty. (3) SIDES NEVER SWAPPED -- A is always capture-seed index 0 and in all 13 DIFFERENT trials the alphabetically earlier region. Rebuilt as tools/audio/critic-w1-22-r2-pack.mjs -> reports/packs/w1-22-r3-hard with fixed-width serialisation, independent per-side tod draws, coin-flip side swap, DIFFERENT pairs drawn from AMENDMENT B's four duplicate triples, and a leak audit that moves the pack to .rejected and exits non-zero if any of six mechanical features beats 0.70.

SUCCESSOR-2 / INCIDENTAL DEFECT, NOT THIS PIECE'S: the default player race is `argonian`, which is not a key in game/data/progression/race-reactions.json's law_factor (that table calls it `saxhleel`). thresholds() therefore THROWS inside the fixed step as soon as a guard is stepped, killing any stepping probe that spawns one. setCharacter({race:'imperial'}) does not reach the field the crime path reads.

SUCCESSOR-2 / REFUSAL FALSIFIED IN THE BROWSER. ambience-onsets.mjs's mute guard, run four ways: at the SHIPPED 4 s fixture full=0, muted(real mute)=0, muted(NO-OP mute)=0 -> the guard passes for BOTH, so it cannot distinguish a working mute from one that does nothing. At 60 s: full=3, muted(real)=0, muted(no-op)=3 -> passes real, REFUSES no-op. So the refusal is a genuine reachable state, and it is unreachable for the reason it exists at the fixture that ships. The guard is not broken; its fixture is. Remedy: assert full.fired > 0 and size the fixture to the longest interval band.

SUCCESSOR-2 / CONSUMPTION MEASURED, ADMISSIBLE. 89 entities, player walking, same seed, 6 state-hash samples per arm. Perturbing the ambience model on 177 fields (every level_db -60, every event_gain_db 0, every event list emptied, emitters removed, bed_gain_db -60) leaves EVERY state hash, entity position and alert value IDENTICAL to the null arm. The positive control -- the stealth detection sound-radius table x8, 21 fields -- diverges at the first sample. The null arm re-run AFTER the destructive arm reproduces the first null exactly, so the in-place restore is sound and the null result is not a teardown artefact. RULING: the model IS consumed on the AUDIO path (AmbienceDriver stepped from _afterStep; 413 real events measured out of the render) but has NO entity-side consumer -> seam_sterile: true, reported under AR-3 rather than scored 0 under a clause written for a different failure. The builder's spectral_distance evidence does NOT stand as a consumption demonstration: it measures the audio model with the audio model.

SUCCESSOR-2 / SHIPPED GATES AT HEAD 5d88b7e, 180 s: O1_events_are_audible FAILS (detect_ratio 0.656; salt-hills/day, salt-hills/night and market/night detect ZERO onsets), O2_events_change_the_dynamics FAILS (11 bed/tod rows below the 3 dB bar), O3_level_in_band PASSES with zero failures while 54 of 413 events sit outside the band. Two of the three standing gates are red on the tree as shipped.

SUCCESSOR-2 / R5 VIOLATED FOR 9 OF 13 REGIONS, verified independently at HEAD from a fresh 180 s render: every measured quantity and every event is IDENTICAL day vs night for clay-moor, crimson-coast, deep-marshes, eastern-rootlands, hive, salt-hills, stone-wastes, thornmarsh, valus-ridge. RI-AUD03 R5 says 'Night is a different L2/L4 selection, not a filter'; in those nine it is not a filter either, it is nothing. Reproduces the predecessor's byte-level digest result from a different tool.
